key_highlights: ASX posts fourth consecutive losing week as bond yields climb, signalling sustained risk-off sentiment
RBA signals continued hikes despite sharp unemployment rise, creating an 'interest rate pincer' for households
AUD experiences a 'trapdoor' move, weakening materially against USD
House prices over halfway to largest 40-year decline; Victorian unemployment surges
Small-cap mining active: Anax Metals, Many Peaks, MinRex, Zenith (WA gold), Aurum (155g/t gold) lead ASX movers
$2.7B in capital raises pressures small-cap liquidity; Star's Sydney casino licence remains suspended
Data centre boom straining energy supply; global AI chip stocks (AMD, Lumentum, SK Hynix) show momentum
Geopolitical risk elevated: China-Trump tensions, US online safety intervention by Shoebridge

sectors.trend: Exploration and small-cap gold names (Zenith, Aurum, Kuniko, Anax, Many Peaks, MinRex) showing strong relative outperformance amid broad ASX weakness; large-cap miners (BHP, RIO, FMG) pressured by AUD weakness and global risk-off
sectors.implications: Gold-linked juniors offer relative safety; iron ore/coal majors face headwinds from China demand uncertainty and AUD depreciation

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish stance despite rising unemployment supports net interest margins but pressures credit growth; 'interest rate pincer' (rising mortgage costs, stagnant deposit rates) strains household balance sheets
sectors.implications: CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC benefit from wider spreads but face rising NPL risk as unemployment climbs and 50%+ of renters struggle financially

sectors.trend: Data centre boom creating energy demand surge but straining supply; 'data centre boom = energy bust' dynamic; AI data centre development proceeding without permits signals regulatory gaps
sectors.implications: Energy generators (AGL, Origin, Snowy Hydro) face demand tailwinds but infrastructure constraints; regulatory risk for unpermitted developments

sectors.trend: House prices over halfway to largest 40-year decline; CBD commercial tower listed at $40m; Dusty Martin selling $20m property portfolio; Victorian unemployment worst in nation
sectors.implications: REITs (VGP, ICPL, DGL) under pressure from falling valuations and rising vacancies; residential builders (MRG, MYC) face demand contraction

sectors.trend: Global AI chip momentum (AMD, Lumentum +10%, SK Hynix eyeing Intel Ohio, Zscaler 46% upside); Salesforce 'New Clippy' launch; AI safety concerns after Medicare breach
sectors.implications: ASX tech (WTC, XRO, SOL) may benefit from global AI capex cycle but face regulatory headwinds from AI safety legislation

sectors.trend: Star's Sydney casino licence suspended; consumer squeeze from interest rate pincer; single-parent penalty debate; food/beverage innovation (Pickle Pepsis, Dragonberry)
sectors.implications: Star Entertainment (STAR.AX) faces prolonged revenue uncertainty; consumer staples (WES, WBC) see defensive rotation

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot despite deteriorating labour market creates stagflation risk
AUD weakness amplifies import costs and pressures commodity exporters' AUD revenue
Property correction deepens, threatening household wealth and bank credit quality
Small-cap mining and gold exploration attract capital rotation from large-caps
AI/tech global momentum vs. domestic regulatory uncertainty
Geopolitical fragmentation (China-Trump, US online safety) adds tail risk

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA continued hikes amid rising unemployment (stagflation)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight rate-sensitive defensives (WES, WBC); underweight rate-sensitive growth; monitor RBA statement for pivot signals
Hedge AUD exposure; favour exporters (BHP, CSL) whose USD revenue benefits; avoid import-heavy consumer names
Reduce REIT and residential builder exposure; monitor NPL trends at major banks

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation (China-Trump, US intervention in AU online safety)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain diversified global exposure; monitor iron ore/coal flows from China

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Small-cap liquidity drain from $2.7B cap raises
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid illiquid micro-caps; focus on ASX 200/300 liquidity; monitor dilution risk

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply constraints from data centre demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AGL/Origin capex guidance; watch for regulatory intervention on unpermitted developments

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold-exposed juniors and large-cap gold miners
opportunities.rationale: AUD weakness, geopolitical risk, and RBA hawkishness support gold; Zenith, Aurum, and Anax showing strong assay results

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive consumer staples and healthcare
opportunities.rationale: Interest rate pincer and unemployment rise drive rotation to defensives; CSL benefits from AUD weakness via USD revenue

opportunities.recommendation: Selective energy/infrastructure exposure for data centre demand
opportunities.rationale: Structural energy demand from AI data centres supports generators and grid infrastructure names

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and residential property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: House prices over halfway to 40-year decline; CBD commercial valuations compressing; Victorian unemployment worst nationally

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and reduce rate-sensitive growth exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD trapdoor and RBA hiking cycle create headwinds for domestic growth equities; bond yields climbing

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid illiquid small-caps amid $2.7B cap raise wave
defensive_moves.rationale: Dilution risk and liquidity drain from heavy capital raising activity

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to extend losses in 1-3 month window; fourth consecutive weekly decline, rising bond yields, and RBA hawkishness create persistent headwinds. AUD weakness may provide partial support for exporters but broad risk-off dominates. Expect volatility around RBA communications and US-China geopolitical developments.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious: stagflation risk (hiking into unemployment) pressures earnings; property correction may take 12-18 months to stabilise. Gold, healthcare, and energy infrastructure offer relative resilience. Global AI capex cycle provides a structural tailwind for tech-adjacent names. Recovery contingent on RBA pivot and labour market stabilisation.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (hawkish hold or hike)
AUD/USD trajectory and RBA intervention risk
Australian CPI and unemployment data (next release)
Global AI chip earnings (Nvidia, AMD, Intel)
watch_list: RBA cash rate and 3-month bill yield
Iron ore (62% Fe) and gold spot prices
CoreLogic house price index (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane)
BHP.AX, CSL.AX, CBA.AX – large-cap sentiment proxies
US 10-year yield and global bond market stress
Data centre energy demand vs. AEMO supply forecasts
